content:
Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) has released the notification for Group C Scaler Recruitment 2026 in the Uttarakhand Forest Development Corporation under Advertisement No. 82/उ0अ0से0च0आ0/2026.

Eligible candidates can apply online from 22/09/2026 to 22/10/2026. Read the official notification for eligibility, physical standards, selection procedure, age limit, pay scale and other details.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 22/09/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 22/10/2026
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date: 22/10/2026
  • Correction Date: 26-27 October 2026
  • PET / PST Exam Start: 19/11/2026
  • Result: As per schedule

Application Fee

  • General / OBC: ₹300
  • SC / ST / EWS / PH: ₹150

Pay the examination fee online through debit card, credit card or net banking.

Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 28 years as on 01/07/2026

Age relaxation is applicable as per UKSSSC rules.

Vacancy Details

  • Post: Group C Scaler, Uttarakhand Forest Development Corporation
  • Total Posts: 200
  • Category distribution: UR 105, OBC 27, EWS 21, SC 39, ST 8

Physical Standards

Male: Height 163 cm; 25 km run within 4 hours; shot put 7.275 kg for 5.00 m; long jump 4.00 m; high jump 1.10 m; chest expansion 5%.

Female: Height 150 cm; 14 km run within 4 hours; shot put 5.00 kg for 3.50 m; long jump 2.00 m; high jump 0.70 m; chest expansion 5%.

Verify all physical, eligibility and application requirements in the official notification before applying.
